why: Where it started for Xavier, Magneto, Cyclops and Mystique. Their split over how mutants should live alongside humans is the core of a relationship Doomsday brings back.
Deepens the Xavier–Magneto rivalry and introduces Alan Cumming's Nightcrawler. If you only watch one legacy X-Men film, guides say make it this one.
Steve Rogers' origin and his story with Peggy Carter. Chris Evans and Hayley Atwell are both confirmed to return.
The team assembles for the first time, and Thor and Loki clash on Earth. This is the original dynamic the new film builds against.
The Russo brothers' previous Avengers event. Wakanda's battle and Thor's arc set up the heroes who are still standing.
Closes out the original team. Steve hands the shield to Sam, Thor leaves still grieving, and Scott Lang's return from the Quantum Realm kicks off the finale.
The only series on the official list. It explains how branching timelines work, and season 2's finale leaves Loki holding the multiverse together — the structure Doomsday threatens.

n: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
why: The only full introduction to Simu Liu's Shang-Chi, who is confirmed for Doomsday.
Proof that characters from other franchises' universes can cross into the MCU. Doomsday does the same thing on a much bigger scale.
Shuri takes up the Black Panther mantle, M'Baku steps up, and Namor's undersea kingdom of Talokan is revealed. All three characters are confirmed.
Sam Wilson's first film as Captain America, with Joaquin Torres as the new Falcon.
The bridge between the Fox-era universe and the MCU, and where Channing Tatum finally plays Gambit, a role he returns to in Doomsday.

n: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
why: The MCU's big look at the wider multiverse, and the film that explains incursions: two universes colliding, with one destroyed.
Yelena, Bucky, Red Guardian, U.S. Agent, Ghost and Sentry form a team, and by the end they're publicly branded the New Avengers.
Meet Reed, Sue, Johnny and Ben in their own retro-future universe. The mid-credits scene was the MCU's first tease of Doctor Doom.
The last MCU movie before Doomsday. Kevin Feige has said it takes place before Doomsday, and Yelena appears in it. Not on Disney+'s list.
Introduces Yelena and Red Guardian, both confirmed, and their family history with Natasha. Makes Thunderbolts* hit harder.

n: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
why: Sam decides whether to pick up the shield, Bucky confronts his past, and John Walker first takes the Captain America title and disgraces it.
The latest look at Scott Lang and the grown-up Cassie (Kathryn Newton), both confirmed for Doomsday.
The final chapter of the WandaVision trilogy, and the last MCU release before Doomsday. Stay for the second post-credits scene in episode 8: it leads straight into the movie.
Worth it for the mid-credits scene, which brought Kelsey Grammer's Beast into the MCU as an early sign the X-Men were coming.
